#####TL;DR The sophons establish a settlement at the bottom left corner of 11k by the Sea of Sins and Xeos encounters a Lethe.

Xeos had been traveling for at least 4 days to find a good area for a settlement. Things had been going well; most creatures felt the faint rumble in the ground as he walked and fled the area as he moved and those that showed malicious intent were dispatched quickly.

He was beginning to see the coast on the horizon and thought that it looked like a good area for a port settlement. He focused on his Archive Communication stone and spoke aloud saying "I think that I may have found the perfect place for our fist settlement as well as a good time to test the [Man Cannon](http://img08.deviantart.net/f935/i/2012/093/3/c/unsc_mac__mass_driver__onager__by_thelvoramee-d4uv6kt.jpg). Start charging the banks."

#####The Personnel Rail is basically a cannon to launch Sophons clad in Armor of Strength and Speed to far off places. It currently only reaches anywhere on High Peaks (1) due to issues of air and newly acquired space junk.

After he spoke a voice was heard saying "Alright but you will need to put a landing area designator in the area where you want them to land at some point."

"I know"

"We'll let you know when we're ready for a test fire."

"Alright. I'll make sure the area is clear first."

Xeos begins making his way down the hill he was on when he began to sense a disturbance off to his side coming in his direction. Expecting hostility from the creature's movements, Xeos instinctively turns up the power going in to his magic converter and activating his Optic Veil as it moves closer. Keeping his awareness on the creature, Xeos begins moving back down the hill again and readying himself for a potential fight.

As he reaches the bottom of the slope he hears, "The banks are charged and we're ready to fire"

Turning his attention away from the creature Xeos responds, "Okay. I'll let you know when I'm ready"

As this is said the creature lunges at Xeos and wraps its arms around him.

Xeos stands confused.

#####I assume the Lethe need a physical touch?

He proceeds to grab the creature by the head, swing it so hard that it's body rips from its head and flies into a tree then breaks in half, and smashes the head in his hand. He then relays what just happened to Gaellor and they do a quick search of the Archives and learn that this creature is called a 'Lethe'; although the creature was exhibiting behavior unrecorded in the Archives so they include this new information and instruct Xeos as well as all of Gaellor to obliterate any they come across on sight.

#####Sorry, gotta protect their knowledge and people.

The young Sophon arrives at the area he spoke of and clears it for others. Then he tells Gaellor "I've cleared a space and I am ready for impact. My coordinates are the SouthWestern corner of Eleven K. Fire away."

He felt two small shakes in the ground and waited to see the First of his brethren to arrive with supplies.

He sees the first pod flying trough the sky followed by a Sophon wearing a suit of their armor, branded by many of Gaellor inhabitants as 'power armor' because 'Armor of Strength and Speed' is a bit of a handful to say.

The other Sophon Xildni and supplies landed safely.

"They've landed safely"

"Good. Set up a landing zone and we'll begin sending more people to help build and study the area."

Xeos, with the help of this other Xildni, setup the landing zone and began constructing a small [keep](http://www.timeref.com/content/imgs/white_tower_london.jpg) for the city in case of hostile beings near. Xeos asks those at Gaellor what the name of this city shall be called and, they tell him that he can name it.

He ponders this for a few minutes then turns to the other Sophon and says "Megrutha"

And so the city of Megrutha is created as more Sophons arrive and build more buildings and docks for future trade.
